intent: Bind one-use gateway acquire_v2 to Root-authenticated scope preimage while preserving v1 rehearsal, no retry or refund, and disabled production.

findings.suggested_fix: Add independent route and tariff mismatch cases with a recomputed scope digest in both root and call, and assert refusal with no begin or capture calls.
findings.title: Exercise route and tariff checks after a valid scope digest
findings.why_it_matters: A regression removing the broker's route or tariff binding checks would still pass the tests named for those checks. Both altered scopes retain the original root digest, so the digest comparison rejects them before either binding check runs. Recompute the scope digest and update both root and call for each altered scope while retaining the mismatched binding route or tariff, then assert refusal before begin.
